entries.name: Demon Hunter
entries: The first demon hunter was {@creature Illidan Stormrage|WoW}, a night elf sorcerer (and brother of Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage) who betrayed his people and all of Azeroth during the War of the Ancients, the first invasion of the Burning Legion. Secretly planning to learn the Legion's secrets in order to undermine the demonic forces from within, Illidan mastered the Legion's magic and received magical gifts from the fallen titan Sargeras. (See chapter 6 for more about {@book Sargeras and the Burning Legion|WoW|6|Burning Legion}.)

Following Illidan's example, demon hunters (often called Illidari) sacrifice their sight, family ties, and personal aspirations in exchange for fel power they use to battle the Legion. They begin their training by slaying a demon, eating its heart, and drinking its blood, allowing them to tap into demonic powers. Their physical sight is replaced by a supernatural sense, which at short range lets them perceive the truth of illusions and see hidden enemies. But their demonic features incite revulsion and dread among other people.
